business-minimal.label: 商务极简
business-minimal.use: 管理汇报、方案沟通、领导层演示
business-minimal.art_direction: restrained executive presentation with calm confidence and generous negative space
business-minimal.composition: asymmetric editorial grid, conclusion first, one strong visual anchor, precise alignment
business-minimal.palette: warm off-white, near-black, muted forest green, restrained amber accent
business-minimal.typography: clean modern Chinese sans serif, stable proportions, no decorative lettering
business-minimal.imagery: credible contemporary workplace or architectural photography with natural light
business-minimal.materials: matte paper, subtle rules, crisp image crops

editorial.label: 编辑叙事
editorial.use: 行业观点、品牌故事、趋势演讲
editorial.art_direction: premium independent magazine spread with a strong point of view
editorial.composition: asymmetric page rhythm, serif-led headline, cropped documentary image, intentional tension
editorial.palette: paper ivory, carbon black, oxide red, muted marine blue
editorial.typography: high-contrast Chinese serif headline paired with restrained sans-serif supporting copy
editorial.imagery: documentary editorial photography with visible texture and honest light
editorial.materials: uncoated paper grain, hairline rules, print-like image treatment

swiss-grid.label: 瑞士网格
swiss-grid.use: 设计发布、文化活动、鲜明观点
swiss-grid.art_direction: international typographic style with rigorous grid and poster energy
swiss-grid.composition: strict modular grid, hard alignment, oversized type, geometric crop, visible spatial logic
swiss-grid.palette: warm white, true black, signal red, International Klein blue
swiss-grid.typography: bold grotesk Chinese sans serif with disciplined scale contrast
swiss-grid.imagery: high-contrast architectural or abstract photography treated as a geometric block
swiss-grid.materials: flat ink, sharp edges, no shadows

launch-tech.label: 科技发布
launch-tech.use: 产品发布、技术演讲、开发者大会
launch-tech.art_direction: cinematic technology keynote, engineered and credible rather than science-fiction fantasy
launch-tech.composition: dark stage, strong left-to-right information flow, one luminous technical visual, clear focal hierarchy
launch-tech.palette: near-black teal, cool white, electric cyan, small warm amber signal
launch-tech.typography: precise geometric Chinese sans serif with occasional monospace micro labels
launch-tech.imagery: abstract data infrastructure, systems, light paths, or engineered macro photography
launch-tech.materials: dark glass, fine technical lines, restrained luminous edges

data-consulting.label: 数据咨询
data-consulting.use: 战略分析、经营汇报、决策建议
data-consulting.art_direction: top-tier strategy consulting narrative with decisive hierarchy and evidence discipline
data-consulting.composition: answer-first headline, compact analytical structure, aligned evidence, clear comparison or process
data-consulting.palette: clean white, charcoal navy, deep teal, restrained coral signal
data-consulting.typography: neutral professional Chinese sans serif optimized for fast scanning
data-consulting.imagery: minimal analytical visual, credible business context, or precise information graphic
data-consulting.materials: crisp white canvas, fine gray rules, flat color signals

academic.label: 学术研究
academic.art_direction: contemporary academic publishing with evidence-led calm and intellectual clarity
academic.composition: publication hierarchy, measured whitespace, figure-led evidence, restrained annotation
academic.palette: soft white, graphite, institutional green, muted burgundy
academic.typography: scholarly Chinese serif headline with highly readable sans-serif labels
academic.imagery: research environment, documentary evidence, or restrained scientific abstraction
academic.materials: archival paper, double rules, subtle figure captions

brand-bold.label: 高能品牌
brand-bold.use: 创意提案、增长活动、品牌发布
brand-bold.art_direction: confident contemporary campaign poster with playful but controlled impact
brand-bold.composition: oversized headline, bold color field, tilted image crop, one memorable graphic gesture
brand-bold.palette: saturated yellow, near-black, vivid coral, deep teal
brand-bold.typography: heavy Chinese display sans serif with compact supporting text
brand-bold.imagery: energetic candid action or tactile product-like photography with direct flash character
brand-bold.materials: flat ink, rough poster edge, sharp offset shadow

premium-dark.label: 高端暗色
premium-dark.use: 高端发布、精品展示、主旨演讲
premium-dark.art_direction: cinematic black-stage keynote with understated luxury and editorial restraint
premium-dark.composition: immersive full-bleed image, low-key lighting, elegant title placement, deep negative space
premium-dark.palette: rich black, warm ivory, brushed gold, restrained mineral teal
premium-dark.typography: elegant Chinese serif title with sparse modern sans-serif support
premium-dark.imagery: low-key cinematic photography with tactile detail and controlled highlights
premium-dark.materials: black lacquer, brushed metal, subtle film grain
